title: Arcforge- Looking for some feedback!
author: Competitive-Yak
selftext:
Roguelike mixed with RPG aspects. Collect awesome gear as you play, upgrade/hone/corrupt them via blacksmith. Get stronger each run. Forge different builds each run. 8 classes,14 Unique bosses so far with over 1000+ different talent nodes total. \~3 months in development Would really appreciate any feed back! Just a note, I was overly geared in this showcase just to show off the game and boss a bit. :D 

1. Progression system: How is difficulty? Does progression feel good or too long to power up? Does getting to your build take too long or the pacing is fine?
2. Class balance/identity: How does each class feel?
3. Gameplay smoothness: Any lag spikes? FPS drops?
4. How is animations and visuals?
5. Sound effects/Music?

comments.author: Flashy-Purple-4403
comments.body:
There is a recent video from Chris Wilson where he goes about his opinion on Halls of Torment. You could maybe watch it, I think it has some good insights that could apply to your game.

For me, your game is still lacking polish on the UI, there is too much text going on the choices, the color palette is kinda fighting itself as well. You could maybe apply iconography/keywords to simplify the cognitive burden of the player.

Best of luck on improving it 😀

replies.author: Competitive-Yak
replies.body: This is actually great feedback. I agree with you and will definitely watch the video. The options have so much text. I can definately remove alot of the texts. Most of it just shows the scaling and cooldowns, which you probably dont need to see.

replies.author: Competitive-Yak
replies.body: Thanks for feedback. Will look into this. Wondering how to resolve this issue... dim down the colors? I guess this was like a end game showcase of what it looks like. Early game its not so chaotic.

comments.author: GCC_GicaCamelCase
comments.body:
I think the fundamental question is: why would someone play your game over the game it tries to copy (vampire survivors in this case)? I'm pro AI, but if I saw your game in steam discovery queue, I'd instantly hit next because it has the low effort AI-made game graphics: I like the mobs even though the animations are lacking, the skill icons have too much details compared to everything else (which makes the style incoherent), and UI is just ugly/samey/the kind of thing you see in the "I made this game with opus5.5 in 3 days" posts. I'm not sure if it's the background or something else, but for me it's hard to read what's going on in the game. If you take the color out, you'll notice that it's very hard to spot your toon because almost everything is white. 

https://i.redd.it/20n5yp5k3czh1.png

  
Other than that, just by going through your video, the game reads to me as "another vampire survivors clone, but much less polished which doesn't add anything new that's meaningful for the genre". I hope you don't see this as rude, but it's how I'd look at it as a customer.

replies.author: Competitive-Yak
replies.body:
https://i.redd.it/i33m7grl8czh1.png

Thanks for the feedback! Alot of valid points!! Will work on UI improvements for sure. Agree it looks terrible now that I'm looking at it from outside POV. Just to be clear though this was a "end game" show case so things are expected to be chaotic! Just like in vampire survivor when you hit end game builds your screen is chaos. I was going for that "feel" as well. Of course in the early game when you first start, its much less chaotic and you see what's going on, i should have showed the progression from the start so thats my fault haha.

I guess its different because there is gear collection and a blacksmithing system that changes how you build each class and playstyle via stats/affixes/skill upgrades. Like you could build giga armor and just facetank everything while reflecting damage, or build full self healing and just heal through everything, or massive DMG and nuke everything. I definitely took inspiration from Vampire survivors, POE/ WoW since those are some of my favorite games and mashed them into one.

comments.author: Dry-Effort-9256
comments.body: I think you’ve probably laid out the bones for a better version of the game, much better UI and visuals in general.
